QUARTERLY ACTIVITIES REPORT  
FOR THE PERIOD ENDED 30 JUNE 2026 
 
Exploration 
 
• 
Drilling program finalised for key gold targets at Morck Well; heritage surveys completed on 
the 21st of July and drilling anticipated to commence in late August. 
 
• 
Commenced conceptual mining optimisation studies at the Forrest copper and gold deposit 
to determine the best pathway for progressing the resources.  
 
• 
Auris continues to evaluate new strategic opportunities to enhance shareholder value. 
 
Corporate 
 
• 
Cash balance at 30 June 2026 of $3.05million. 
 
Gold and base metals explorer Auris Minerals Limited (“Auris” or “the Company”) (ASX: AUR) is 
pleased to provide its Quarterly Activities Report for the quarter ended 30 June 2026. 
Commenting on the June quarter, Auris Managing Director, Mike Hendriks said:  
"Having completed heritage surveying of planned drill lines on 21 July 2026, we anticipate heritage 
approval to be forthcoming, allowing us to commence drilling at Jacques East and Frenchy's South, 
following extensive work prioritising key targets across both projects. 
We've also been reviewing the optionality around extracting value from our Forrest copper deposit, 
particularly in light of the rise in copper price over the past 12 months. CCR Mining Engineering Pty Ltd 
have been engaged to outline potential mining options at the project. 
The Company remains well funded, and we continue to evaluate a range of projects that would 
complement our existing tenure and add shareholder value." 
  
Company Overview 
 
Auris is exploring for base metals and gold in the Bryah Basin of Western Australia. Auris has 
consolidated a tenement portfolio of ~223km², which at 30 June 2026, was divided into two well-
defined project areas: Forrest and Morck Well, (Figure 1). 
Auris manages exploration on all tenements, including those that are subject to arrangements with 
third parties.

1.  EXPLORATION 
 
Exploration activities conducted during the reporting period related to planning future exploration 
programs to advance strategic gold, copper, manganese and other base metal targets on our existing 
tenements. 
 
Following completion of a detailed exploration and prospectivity review across the Company's existing 
tenure, the Company has finalised its upcoming drill program, which will test high-priority gold targets 
at Morck Well. 
 
The Company eagerly anticipates the commencement of an air core drilling program within its Morck 
Well Tenement Group (E51/1033 and E52/1672) to follow up previous gold anomalism at the Jacques 
East and Frenchy's South prospects. The program will comprise 20–26 drill holes. At Jacques East, initial 
drilling will be completed at 100m spacing for 20 holes, as depicted on the plans below, with any areas 
of significant quartz veining or alteration immediately infilled to 50m spacing. The Jacques East gold 
prospect has historically intersected gold mineralisation and is interpreted to host a flat-lying 
supergene component associated with regolith boundaries (refer ASX announcements 17 July 2020 
and 8 August 2023).

At Frenchy's South, drilling will test the distribution and tenor of gold mineralisation at a closer spacing 
(25m spacing from historical drilling) for a total of 6 holes. Frenchy's South has historically returned 
anomalous gold mineralisation over 1.2km (refer ASX announcements 16 April 2019 and 8 August 
2023).

Heritage surveying of the planned drill lines was completed on 21 July 2026, and Auris is currently 
awaiting heritage clearance in order to book in drilling, with drilling contractors already on standby. 
The Company anticipates drilling will commence in late August.  
 
Concurrently, we continue to undertake conceptual mining optimisation studies on the Forrest project 
resources, to determine how best to progress this resource towards mining. CCR Mining Engineering 
Pty Ltd (CCR) have been engaged to provide an independent review of potential mining options at 
Forrest. The scope of work will include copper only, gold only and combined copper/gold. With the 
assistance of the findings from CCR, Auris will undertake further analysis in consultation with Westgold 
Resources who’s interests are outlined in Figure 1 above, before determining next steps. 
 
The resources estimated at Forrest and Wodger deposits comprise a total inferred resource of 2.4 Mt 
@ 1.7% Cu and 0.44g/t Au for 41,500 t Cu and 34,300 oz Au.

2.  CORPORATE SUMMARY 
 
The company’s priority is to commence drilling as soon as possible and test key gold targets at the 
Jacques East and Frenchy’s South prospects at Morck Well. 
 
The Company continues to evaluate  a number of potential project opportunities.  
 
Cash position 
The Company had a cash position of $3.05M at 30 June 2026. 
 
Details of mining exploration activities  
Details of exploration activities during the quarter are set out above.  
 
The $559k of exploration and evaluation and tenement expenditure is comprised of costs incurred on 
geological staff salaries, tenement administration and project evaluation, and final settlement of an 
outstanding stamp duty dispute (refer to Note 6 in the Auris Minerals, Interim Consolidated Financial 
Report for the half year ended 31 December 2025 lodged on ASX, 25 February 2026.) 
 
Details of mining production and development activities  
No production and development activities were undertaken during the quarter.

Competent Person’s Statement 
Information in this announcement that relates to exploration results is based on and fairly represents 
information and supporting documentation prepared and compiled by Mr Matthew Svensson, who is a Member 
of the Australian Institute of Geoscientists.  Mr Svensson is Exploration Manager for Auris Minerals Limited. Mr 
Svensson has sufficient experience, which is relevant to the style of mineralisation and type of deposit under 
consideration, and to the activity which he is undertaking to qualify as a Competent Person, as defined in the 
2012 Edition of the Australasian Code for Reporting Exploration Results, Mineral Resources and Ore Reserves. 
Mr Svensson consents to the inclusion in the announcement of the matters based on this information in the form 
and context in which it appears.

Except where explicitly stated, this announcement contains references to prior exploration results and Mineral

Company. The Company confirms that it is not aware of any new information or data that materially affects the
